status: FROZEN. Changes after this date go in CHANGES_AFTER_FREEZE.MD and are re-validated.

roi.method: behaviour clustering on 600 frames spread across the transmission, one box per lamp (Day 09/11)
roi.note: boxes are re-detected at run time by the frozen ROI settings; Day 20 showed a box 0.5-2x or shifted half a width changes < 1% of bits

signal_processing.aggregation: mean of the brightest 25% of pixels in the box
signal_processing.evidence: Day 12 ablation: every cleaning option lowers on/off separation; Day 20: smoothing >3 frames is fatal

synchronisation.bits_per_second_basis: ASSUMED from the filename; not confirmed by the data (Days 10, 13); Day 20: a 0.2% error is a coin toss over 3,000 bits
synchronisation.phase_basis: declared, not estimated - the confidence score is flat across phase (Day 15); the ensemble mask reports which bits depend on it

decoder.selection: Day 19 E19-02 on synthetic validation BER at phase 0 (6.19% vs 12.05% for the Day 09 rule); Day 21: equivalent to 'average' on the phase axis, simpler, threshold-immune

split.real: within-video time split - first 30% DEV (tuning), last 70% TEST (opened once, Day 21; re-run unchanged on Day 23)
split.synthetic: seeds 0-3 train, 10-13/20-23 test (Day 17-18), 30-33 validation (Day 19), 50-53 final test (Day 21)
split.why_not_by_video: four videos of four different setups - one per condition (Day 07 s6)

evaluation.note: No ground truth was supplied. Real-data numbers are internal-consistency indicators, never correctness.
